<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Subnational programme context</h4>
<p>District/unit level; 4 categories; API; Classification 0 - prevention of reintroduction: API=0 ; Classifciation 1 -elimination: API&lt;1; Classification 2 - pre-elimination: API 1–&lt;2; Classification 3 - intensified control: API≥2</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Cross-border context</h4>
<p>Especially from Pakistan, Nepal, Myanmar and Bangladesh</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Mobile and migrant population context</h4>
<p>Continuous influx of mobile and migrant populations from high transmission states and bordering countries</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>High-risk populations</h4>
<p>Widespread transmission; tribal communities, low-income households, pregnant women and young children</p>
</div>
</div>
